title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
山西鄉試錄序
我
皇上自郢藩入承大統明年壬午
改元嘉靖秋八月實天下鄉
試之期山西省臣舉故事白
於巡按御史沈〔俊〕〔俊〕曰此
龍飛第一科鄉試也
===
皇上勵精圖治雖萬幾日至未有
急於求賢者求賢以科目庸
非
聖政第一端邪吾儕盍相與慎之
乃以取士必得爲務其司考
校弁百執事悉惟其人時刑
部右侍郎兼僉都御史臧〔鳳〕
punctuated:
山西鄉試錄序

我皇上自郢藩入承大統，明年壬午，改元嘉靖。秋八月，實天下鄉試之期。山西省臣舉故事，白於巡按御史沈〔俊〕。〔俊〕曰：「此龍飛第一科鄉試也。皇上勵精圖治，雖萬幾日至，未有急於求賢者。求賢以科目，庸非聖政第一端邪？吾儕盍相與慎之？」乃以取士必得爲務，其司考校弁百執事，悉惟其人。時刑部右侍郎兼僉都御史臧〔鳳〕
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Shanxi Provincial Examination

Our Emperor came from the Ying princely establishment to succeed to the imperial throne. The following year, renwu (1522), he inaugurated the Jiajing reign era. The eighth month of autumn was the appointed time for Provincial Examinations throughout the realm. Following established precedent, the provincial officials of Shanxi reported to Regional Inspector Shen Jun. Jun said: “This is the first Provincial Examination since the Emperor’s accession. The Emperor devotes himself diligently to good government. Although myriad affairs come before him daily, none is more urgent than seeking worthy men. Is not seeking worthy men through the examinations the foremost undertaking of sagely government? Should we not together attend to it with care?”

They therefore made it their task to ensure that the selection of scholars yielded suitable men. Those responsible for examining and grading, together with [?] all the other functionaries, were chosen for their suitability. At that time, Zang Feng, Right Vice Minister of Justice and concurrently Assistant Censor-in-chief, …

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
來督軍務亦重求才鎮守山
西太監張〔景昌〕雅好文事巡
撫都御史胡〔鉉〕楊〔志學〕力爲
崇獎以風士類清戎御史張
〔英〕巡鹽御史朱〔定昌〕協贊厥
成恤刑刑部郎中李〔楫〕亦樂
與盛事於是〔大清〕與教諭粘
===
〔燦〕學正程〔洪政〕蔣〔鉞〕教諭陳
〔介〕陳〔奇〕林〔繼顯〕訓導路〔中〕以
聘至自四方竽文柄焉內而
提調則左布政使楊〔惟康〕右
叅政馬〔卿〕監試則按察使孫
〔脩〕副使陳〔軾〕佐理防範于外
則右布政使劉〔澤〕左叅政秦
punctuated: 來督軍務，亦重求才。鎮守山西太監張〔景昌〕雅好文事，巡撫都御史胡〔鉉〕、楊〔志學〕力爲崇獎，以風士類。清戎御史張〔英〕、巡鹽御史朱〔定昌〕協贊厥成，恤刑刑部郎中李〔楫〕亦樂與盛事。於是〔大清〕與教諭粘〔燦〕、學正程〔洪政〕、蔣〔鉞〕、教諭陳〔介〕、陳〔奇〕、林〔繼顯〕、訓導路〔中〕，以聘至自四方，竽文柄焉。內而提調，則左布政使楊〔惟康〕、右叅政馬〔卿〕；監試，則按察使孫〔脩〕、副使陳〔軾〕；佐理防範于外，則右布政使劉〔澤〕、左叅政秦
translation_en: …came to supervise military affairs and likewise attached importance to seeking talent. Zhang Jingchang, the eunuch stationed in Shanxi as Regional Commander, had a longstanding fondness for literary pursuits. Grand Coordinators and Censors-in-chief Hu Xuan and Yang Zhixue vigorously promoted and rewarded learning to encourage the scholars. Zhang Ying, the censor charged with reviewing military administration, and Zhu Dingchang, the Salt-inspecting Censor, cooperated to bring the undertaking to fruition. Li Ji, a Director in the Ministry of Justice charged with reviewing criminal cases, also gladly participated in this distinguished occasion. Thus Daqing, together with county school instructors Nian Can, Chen Jie, Chen Qi, and Lin Jixian; department school instructors Cheng Hongzheng and Jiang Yue; and Assistant Instructor Lu Zhong, came by invitation from various quarters to wield authority over literary assessment [?]. Within the examination compound, the Proctors were Yang Weikang, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Ma Qing, Right Administration Vice Commissioner. Those overseeing the examination were Sun Xiu, Provincial Surveillance Commissioner, and Chen Shi, Surveillance Vice Commissioner. Assisting with arrangements and security outside were Liu Ze, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Qin, Left Administration Vice Commissioner…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
右叅政李〔偉元〕左叅議韓〔邦〕
右叅議許〔靖雲〕副使袁〔鵬損〕
閔〔槐登〕田僉事尹〔京〕金〔鯉〕谷
張〔高文〕喬〔選岱〕倪〔璣〕以暨都
指揮僉事袁〔勛〕李〔鑑〕御史沈
〔俊〕實監臨焉合提學副使周
〔宣〕所選士千四百有奇試之
===
遵
制額取六十五人録其姓氏并
文之優者獻諸
天府傳之天下〔大清〕當序諸首
簡惟取士之法肇于唐虞敷
納以言明庶以功厥惟舊矣
士欲自見於世與齊民異舍
punctuated:
右叅政李〔偉元〕、左叅議韓〔邦〕、右叅議許〔靖雲〕、副使袁〔鵬損〕、閔〔槐登〕、田、僉事尹〔京〕、金〔鯉〕、谷、張〔高文〕、喬〔選岱〕、倪〔璣〕，以暨都指揮僉事袁〔勛〕、李〔鑑〕，御史沈〔俊〕實監臨焉。合提學副使周〔宣〕所選士千四百有奇，試之，遵制額取六十五人，録其姓氏并文之優者，獻諸天府，傳之天下。〔大清〕當序諸首簡。
惟取士之法，肇于唐虞，敷納以言，明庶以功，厥惟舊矣。士欲自見於世，與齊民異，舍
translation_en:
…Right Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner Li Weiyuan, Left Provincial Administration Assistant Commissioner Han Bang, and Right Provincial Administration Assistant Commissioner Xu Jingyun; Surveillance Vice Commissioners Yuan Pengsun [?], Min Huaideng [?], and Tian [given name missing?]; Surveillance Assistant Commissioners Yin Jing, Jin Li, Gu [given name missing?], Zhang Gaowen [?], Qiao Xuandai [?], and Ni Ji; together with Assistant Regional Military Commissioners Yuan Xun and Li Jian. Censor Shen Jun served as Supervising Official. They assembled and examined the more than fourteen hundred candidates selected by Zhou Xuan, the Surveillance Vice Commissioner in charge of education. In accordance with the imperially prescribed quota, they selected sixty-five men. They recorded their names together with the best of their compositions, submitting these to the imperial repository and circulating them throughout the realm. It fell to Daqing to write a preface for the opening leaves.
The method of selecting worthy men originated in the ages of Tang and Yu: broadly admitting men on the basis of their words and distinguishing them by their achievements. Its origins are indeed ancient. If a scholar wishes to make himself known in the world and distinguish himself from the common people, apart from…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
是奚以哉在後世則文章事
業之謂也嘗觀
國初以來晉士得人爲盛叅政
樞者以道學尊任卿孤者以
才猷著列侍從者以論思顯
居言路者以讜直聞領藩臬
者以風節播其他官守雖崇
===
卑不同率剛毅有爲稱其職
則嘖嘖歎曰其事業有是哉
屬當大比得徧觀其試卷文
取其溫純而有則論與其朗
暢而能精表嘉其駢儷而不
浮判許其援據而有斷策美
其博雅而善陳氣之昌識之
punctuated:
是奚以哉？在後世，則文章事業之謂也。嘗觀國初以來，晉士得人爲盛：叅政樞者以道學尊，任卿孤者以才猷著，列侍從者以論思顯，居言路者以讜直聞，領藩臬者以風節播。其他官守雖崇卑不同，率剛毅有爲，稱其職，則嘖嘖歎曰：「其事業有是哉！」
屬當大比，得徧觀其試卷。文取其溫純而有則，論與其朗暢而能精，表嘉其駢儷而不浮，判許其援據而有斷，策美其博雅而善陳。氣之昌，識之
translation_en:
…by what means could they do so? In later ages, this has meant literary accomplishment and achievements in office. I have observed that, since the founding of the dynasty, Shanxi has been particularly rich in men of worth. Those participating in the central direction of government have been esteemed for their learning of the Way; those serving as ministers and Junior Guardians have been distinguished by their talents and judgment; those in attendance upon the throne have won distinction through deliberation and reflection; those holding remonstrance posts have been known for forthright speech; and those directing provincial administration and surveillance have enjoyed renown for their integrity. The others, though occupying offices of differing rank, have generally been resolute and capable, fulfilling their duties well. Thus I have exclaimed in admiration: “Such are their achievements in office!”
Now, on the occasion of the triennial examination, I have been able to read all their examination papers. In the essays on the classics, I value their gentle refinement and adherence to proper standards; in the discourses, I commend their lucidity, fluency, and precision; in the memorials, I praise their balanced parallel phrasing, free of superficiality; in the legal judgments, I approve their citation of authorities and decisiveness; and in the policy essays, I admire their breadth of learning, elegance, and skill in exposition. The abundance of their vital force, the … of their understanding…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
䆒才之充養之正皆可見焉
又嘖嘖歎曰其文章有是哉
按山西古冀州域當天地之
中經以太行緯以黄河名山
喬嶽次第拱列風水之佳於
天下爲第一故堯舜禹以都
皐夔稷契輩出其間至於今
===
猶異又地高磽瘠不生物俗
尚儉勤雖君臣俱聖猶更相
警戒以帥天下惴惴焉惟荒
寧是懼人才淬礪實趣之成
爲言爲功卓不可尚亦勢所
必爾此堯舜禹之見出尋常
萬萬誠天下第一鄰會耶□
punctuated:
䆒、才之充、養之正，皆可見焉。又嘖嘖歎曰：「其文章有是哉！」
按山西，古冀州域，當天地之中，經以太行，緯以黄河，名山喬嶽次第拱列，風水之佳於天下爲第一。故堯舜禹以都，皐夔稷契輩出其間，至於今猶異。又地高磽瘠，不生物，俗尚儉勤。雖君臣俱聖，猶更相警戒，以帥天下，惴惴焉惟荒寧是懼。人才淬礪，實趣之成，爲言爲功，卓不可尚，亦勢所必爾。此堯舜禹之見，出尋常萬萬，誠天下第一鄰會耶？□
translation_en:
…the depth of their understanding, the fullness of their talent, and the correctness of their cultivation can all be discerned here. Again I exclaimed in admiration: “Such is the excellence of their writing!”
Now Shanxi lies within the territory of ancient Jizhou, at the center of Heaven and Earth. The Taihang Mountains form its warp and the Yellow River its weft; famous mountains and lofty peaks stand arrayed in succession around it. The excellence of its geomantic configuration ranks first under Heaven. Thus Yao, Shun, and Yu established their capitals here, and Gao, Kui, Ji, and Xie arose in its midst. Even today it remains exceptional. Moreover, its land is high, stony, and barren, yielding little produce, and its customs prize frugality and diligence. Although ruler and ministers alike were sages, they still admonished one another as they led all under Heaven, anxiously fearing only negligence and complacency. Men of talent were tempered and honed, thereby hastening their full development. In their words and achievements, they were outstanding beyond compare; this, too, was the inevitable consequence of their circumstances. Such was the discernment of Yao, Shun, and Yu, surpassing the ordinary ten thousandfold. Was this truly the foremost gathering place [?] under Heaven? [Illegible character]…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
予删書斷自唐虞爲後世法
學者類欲深造遠詣遡三代
以至唐虞爲第一義况產其
地鍾其秀憂深思遠猶有遺
風其自待顧可淺哉往者權
姦竊柄禍我衣冠文運嘗大
厄矣今
===
聖明天縱光啓中興
登極一詔天下欣然若更生
山陵未畢即
御講筵拔茅脫距汲汲恐後恢
張太平之業比隆唐虞端在
於此又天下第一大機會也
諸士窮居憂世恒遡與時違
punctuated:
予删書，斷自唐虞，爲後世法。學者類欲深造遠詣，遡三代以至唐虞，爲第一義。况產其地，鍾其秀，憂深思遠，猶有遺風，其自待顧可淺哉？往者權姦竊柄，禍我衣冠，文運嘗大厄矣。
今聖明天縱，光啓中興。登極一詔，天下欣然若更生。山陵未畢，即御講筵，拔茅脫距，汲汲恐後，恢張太平之業，比隆唐虞，端在於此，又天下第一大機會也。諸士窮居憂世，恒遡與時違
translation_en:
…I edited the Documents, beginning with the reigns of Tang Yao and Yu Shun, to provide a model for later ages. Scholars generally aspire to profound learning and far-reaching attainment, taking as their foremost principle the tracing of antiquity through the Three Dynasties back to Tang Yao and Yu Shun. How much more should those born in this land, endowed with its finest influences and still preserving its legacy of deep concern and far-reaching thought, expect of themselves! Could their aspirations possibly be modest? Formerly, powerful traitors usurped authority and brought calamity upon our scholar-officials; the fortunes of learning suffered a grave ordeal.
Now our sagely and enlightened sovereign, endowed by Heaven, has gloriously inaugurated a restoration. With a single edict upon his accession, all under Heaven rejoiced as though reborn. Even before the imperial mausoleum was completed, he attended the imperial lectures, drawing worthy men into service and freeing them from constraints [?], pressing forward as though afraid of falling behind. The expansion of the enterprise of Great Peace, to rival the flourishing reigns of Tang Yao and Yu Shun, depends precisely upon this. This, too, is an opportunity foremost under Heaven. You scholars, living in straitened circumstances and concerned for the world, have constantly lamented [?] being out of step with the times…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
無階上達爲憾茲以賓興觀
光
京國固已陟仕進第一階矣嗣
是登甲科服官守馴底于極
雲龍風虎適逢其會胡忍使
失之夫事業如前所云亦盛
矣其猶非功之至乎文章如
===
前所云亦佳矣其猶非言之
至乎盍求諸皐夔稷契之徒
形于敷納者何如驗于明庶
者何如堯舜其君者何如堯
舜其民者何如彼何人也予
何人也有爲者亦若是乃其
至爾先正有言以第一等事
punctuated: 無階上達爲憾。茲以賓興，觀光京國，固已陟仕進第一階矣。嗣是登甲科，服官守，馴底于極，雲龍風虎，適逢其會，胡忍使失之？夫事業如前所云，亦盛矣，其猶非功之至乎？文章如前所云，亦佳矣，其猶非言之至乎？盍求諸皐夔稷契之徒？形于敷納者何如？驗于明庶者何如？堯舜其君者何如？堯舜其民者何如？彼何人也？予何人也？有爲者亦若是，乃其至爾。先正有言：「以第一等事
translation_en: …regretting that you had no avenue through which to make yourselves heard above. Now, through selection as worthy men and ceremonial reception as guests, you come to behold the splendor of the capital and have already ascended the first step toward official advancement. Hereafter, you may attain the highest examination honors, discharge official responsibilities, and gradually reach the summit. As clouds follow the dragon and winds the tiger, you have met precisely the right opportunity: how could you bear to let it slip away? Achievements such as those described above are indeed splendid; yet might they still fall short of the highest accomplishment? Writings such as those described above are indeed fine; yet might they still fall short of the highest expression? Why not seek the answer among men such as Gao, Kui, Ji, and Xie? What did they manifest when presenting their counsel for acceptance? What was verified through their accomplishments in the various affairs of government? How did they make their ruler a Yao or Shun? How did they make their people like the people of Yao and Shun? What sort of men were they? What sort of man am I? Those who resolve to act can likewise become such men: only this is the highest attainment. A former worthy said: “To yield to others in undertakings of the first rank…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
讓人則爲自棄〔大清〕於諸士
辱知已敢因地與時重以相
勗誠欲其奮庸熙載追踪往
哲弼成唐虞之治庶幾免於
自棄不愧其産爲天下第一
流人物科目于焉有光吾亦
藉以塞吾責也顧不韙歟
===
江西撫州府崇仁縣儒學教
諭劉〔大清〕謹序
punctuated:
讓人，則爲自棄。〔大清〕於諸士辱知已，敢因地與時，重以相勗，誠欲其奮庸熙載，追踪往哲，弼成唐虞之治，庶幾免於自棄，不愧其産，爲天下第一流人物。科目于焉有光，吾亦藉以塞吾責也，顧不韙歟？

江西撫州府崇仁縣儒學教諭劉〔大清〕謹序。
translation_en:
…to yield to others is to abandon oneself. I, Daqing, have been honored by you gentlemen with your friendship [?]. Taking this place and this occasion as my grounds, I venture once more to offer mutual encouragement. I earnestly wish that you will exert your abilities in service, bring your undertakings to fulfillment, follow in the footsteps of past worthies, and assist in achieving the government of Tang and Yu. Thus you may hope to avoid abandoning yourselves, prove worthy of your birthplace, and become men of the foremost rank in the realm. The examination system will thereby gain distinction, and I too may rely on this to discharge my responsibility. Would this not indeed be fitting?

Respectfully composed as a preface by Liu Daqing 劉大清, Instructor of the Confucian School of Chongren County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi.

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
嘉靖元年山西鄉試
監臨官
巡按山西監察御史沈俊〔人保直隸廬州衛官籍　揚州府泰州人辛未進士〕
提調官
山西等處承宣布政使司左布政使楊惟康〔叔安河南靈寶縣人　己未進士〕
山西等處承宣布政使司右參政馬卿〔敬臣河南林縣人　乙丑進士〕
監試官
山西等處提刑按察司按察使孫脩〔用吉錦衣衛籍直隸　邯鄲縣人乙丑進士〕
山西等處提刑按察司副使陳軾〔子敬湖廣應城縣人　乙丑進士〕
===
考試官
江西撫州府崇仁縣儒學教諭劉大清〔思憲福建莆田縣人　庚午貢士〕
浙江杭州府仁和縣儒學教諭粘燦〔中美福建晉江縣人　辛酉貢士〕
同考試官
山東青州府莒州儒學學正程洪政〔尚德江西樂平縣人　甲子貢士〕
山東兗州府濟寧州儒學學正蔣鉞〔廷威福建侯官縣人　己卯貢士〕
直隸淮安府安東縣儒學教諭陳界〔尚廉河南汝陽縣人　己卯貢士〕
山東濟南府泰安州新泰縣儒學教諭陳音〔上眷福建晉江縣人　癸酉貢士〕
直隸揚州府泰州如皐縣儒學教諭林繼顯〔德純福建侯官縣人　癸酉貢士〕
punctuated:
嘉靖元年山西鄉試

監臨官：
巡按山西監察御史沈俊〔人保，直隸廬州衛官籍，揚州府泰州人，辛未進士〕。

提調官：
山西等處承宣布政使司左布政使楊惟康〔叔安，河南靈寶縣人，己未進士〕。
山西等處承宣布政使司右參政馬卿〔敬臣，河南林縣人，乙丑進士〕。

監試官：
山西等處提刑按察司按察使孫脩〔用吉，錦衣衛籍，直隸邯鄲縣人，乙丑進士〕。

浙江杭州府仁和縣儒學教諭粘燦〔中美，福建晉江縣人，辛酉貢士〕。

山東青州府莒州儒學學正程洪政〔尚德，江西樂平縣人，甲子貢士〕。
山東兗州府濟寧州儒學學正蔣鉞〔廷威，福建侯官縣人，己卯貢士〕。
直隸淮安府安東縣儒學教諭陳界〔尚廉，河南汝陽縣人，己卯貢士〕。
山東濟南府泰安州新泰縣儒學教諭陳音〔上眷，福建晉江縣人，癸酉貢士〕。
直隸揚州府泰州如皐縣儒學教諭林繼顯〔德純，福建侯官縣人，癸酉貢士〕。
translation_en:

Nian Can, Instructor at the Confucian School of Renhe County, Hangzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, had the courtesy name Zhongmei. A native of Jinjiang County, Fujian, he was a tribute scholar of the xinyou year.

Jiang Yue, Instructor at the Confucian School of Jining Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong, had the courtesy name Tingwei. A native of Houguan County, Fujian, he was a tribute scholar of the jimao year.
Chen Jie, Instructor at the Confucian School of Andong County, Huai’an Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Shanglian. A native of Ruyang County, Henan, he was a tribute scholar of the jimao year.
Chen Yin, Instructor at the Confucian School of Xintai County, Tai’an Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, had the courtesy name Shangjuan [?]. A native of Jinjiang County, Fujian, he was a tribute scholar of the guiyou year.

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:

收掌試卷官
太原府知府閻讓〔伯仁陝西邠州人辛酉貢士〕
太原府同知楊士魁〔彥夫河南蘭陽縣人戊辰進士〕
受卷官
山西等處承宣布政使司照磨所照磨畢張〔省夫河南裕州人丁丑進士〕

澤州知州王楊〔惟直，直隸興州後屯衛籍，浙江會稽縣人，辛巳進士〕。
太原府榆次縣知縣尹倫〔天叙，河南汝州人，辛巳進士〕。

translation_en:

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
平陽府解州安邑縣知縣李鋭〔仲之南直隸瀋陽中屯衛籍 江西新喻縣人辛酉貢士〕
謄錄官
平陽府蒲州知州高瀹〔新之直隸江都縣人 丁丑進士〕
潞州同知孔㢠〔德昭南京應天衛籍直 隸臨淮縣人丁丑進士〕
平陽府解州夏縣知縣滎察〔省夫陝西藍田縣人 丁丑進士〕

汾州介休縣知縣王天祐〔受之陝西咸陽衛籍直 隸河間縣人辛酉貢士〕
對讀官

===

平陽府翼城縣知縣孫昂〔一鶴山東昌邑縣人 辛巳進士〕

平陽府絳州稷山縣知縣袁梧〔鳳儀陝西醴泉縣人 丁卯貢士〕

平陽府解州安邑縣知縣李鋭〔仲之，南直隸瀋陽中屯衛籍，江西新喻縣人，辛酉貢士〕。

平陽府蒲州知州高瀹〔新之，直隸江都縣人，丁丑進士〕。潞州同知孔㢠〔德昭，南京應天衛籍，直隸臨淮縣人，丁丑進士〕。平陽府解州夏縣知縣滎察〔省夫，陝西藍田縣人，丁丑進士〕。平陽府蒲州萬泉縣知縣王大節〔汝操，直隸大名縣人，庚午貢士〕。汾州介休縣知縣王天祐〔受之，陝西咸陽衛籍，直隸河間縣人，辛酉貢士〕。

巡綽官：
太原左衛指揮使宮淮〔汝宗，直隸壽州人〕。太原右衛指揮使孟璽〔廷信，直隸山陽縣人〕。平陽衛指揮同知呂忱〔誠之，山東曹縣人〕。

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
太原左衛左所正千户李熈〔時雍直隷鳳陽縣人〕
太原右衛副千户王經〔伯常河南宜陽縣人〕
搜檢官
太原前衛指揮使俞本〔立夫直隷江都縣人〕
太原右衛指揮同知李勳〔世臣直隷合肥縣人〕
太原右衛中所副千户侯經〔廷正直隷滑縣人〕
太原左衛中右所千戸郝振〔叔揚直隷鳳陽縣人〕
太原右衛後所副千户劉鎮〔靖之直隷全椒縣人〕
供給官
===
山西等處承宣布政使司理問所副理問雷瑜〔君瑞陜西蒲城縣人吏員〕
沁州知州曾鉞〔宗儀應天府句容縣人己酉貢士〕

平陽府襄陵縣知縣孫源〔伯濬陜西咸寧縣人丁卯貢士〕
太原府樂平縣知縣石翔〔鳳來直隷長垣縣人庚午貢士〕
潞州黎城縣知縣楊良臣〔舜卿山東即墨縣人戊午貢士〕
太原府祁縣知縣楊本源〔叔用陜西膚施縣人庚午貢士〕

punctuated:
太原左衛左所正千户李熈〔時雍，直隷鳳陽縣人〕。太原右衛副千户王經〔伯常，河南宜陽縣人〕。

搜檢官：太原前衛指揮使俞本〔立夫，直隷江都縣人〕。太原右衛指揮同知李勳〔世臣，直隷合肥縣人〕。太原右衛中所副千户侯經〔廷正，直隷滑縣人〕。太原左衛中右所千戸郝振〔叔揚，直隷鳳陽縣人〕。太原右衛後所副千户劉鎮〔靖之，直隷全椒縣人〕。

供給官：山西等處承宣布政使司理問所副理問雷瑜〔君瑞，陜西蒲城縣人，吏員〕。沁州知州曾鉞〔宗儀，應天府句容縣人，己酉貢士〕。太原府陽曲縣知縣許琦〔君佩，陜西咸寧縣人，丁卯貢士〕。平陽府襄陵縣知縣孫源〔伯濬，陜西咸寧縣人，丁卯貢士〕。太原府樂平縣知縣石翔〔鳳來，直隷長垣縣人，庚午貢士〕。潞州黎城縣知縣楊良臣〔舜卿，山東即墨縣人，戊午貢士〕。太原府祁縣知縣楊本源〔叔用，陜西膚施縣人，庚午貢士〕。平陽府隰州石樓縣知縣王之鄰〔虞卿，山東登州衛人，監生〕。太原府陽曲縣縣丞范正〔中之，河南登封縣人，監生〕。
translation_en:

Searching Officials:
Yu Ben, Guard Commander of the Taiyuan Front Guard, had the courtesy name Lifu and was from Jiangdu County, Zhili. title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
大哉堯之爲君也巍巍乎唯天爲大唯堯
則之蕩蕩乎民無能名焉
詩云鳶飛戾天魚躍于淵言其上下察也
君仁莫不仁君義莫不義君正莫不正一
正君而國定矣
易
忠信所以進德也
===
君子之光其暉吉也
天地之道貞觀者也日月之道貞明者也
天下之動貞夫一者也
子曰知幾其神乎君子上交不諂下交不
瀆其知幾乎幾者動之微吉之先見
者也君子見幾而作不俟終日易曰
介于石不終日貞吉介如石焉寧用
終日斷可識矣君子知微知彰知柔
知剛萬夫之望
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

大哉，堯之爲君也！巍巍乎！唯天爲大，唯堯則之。蕩蕩乎！民無能名焉。

詩云：「鳶飛戾天，魚躍于淵。」言其上下察也。

君仁，莫不仁；君義，莫不義；君正，莫不正。一正君，而國定矣。

易

忠信，所以進德也。

君子之光，其暉吉也。

天地之道，貞觀者也；日月之道，貞明者也；天下之動，貞夫一者也。

子曰：「知幾，其神乎！君子上交不諂，下交不瀆，其知幾乎！幾者，動之微，吉之先見者也。君子見幾而作，不俟終日。易曰：『介于石，不終日，貞吉。』介如石焉，寧用終日？斷可識矣。君子知微知彰，知柔知剛，萬夫之望。」
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

Great indeed was Yao as a ruler! How lofty! Heaven alone is great, and Yao alone took it as his model. How vast were his achievements! The people could find no words to name them.

The Book of Odes says: “The kite flies up to heaven; the fish leap in the depths.” This speaks of the Way’s clear manifestation above and below.

If the ruler is benevolent, none will fail to be benevolent; if the ruler is righteous, none will fail to be righteous; if the ruler is upright, none will fail to be upright. Once the ruler is set right, the state will be settled.

Book of Changes

Loyalty and trustworthiness are the means by which one advances in virtue.

The light of the noble man: its radiance is auspicious.

The Way of heaven and earth is displayed through constancy; the Way of the sun and moon shines through constancy; all movement under heaven is made constant through the One.

The Master said: “To know the incipient signs—is this not a spiritlike capacity! In dealings with those above him, the noble man does not flatter; in dealings with those below him, he is not disrespectfully familiar. Does he not know the incipient signs! These signs are the subtle beginnings of movement, the first indications of good fortune. The noble man sees them and acts, without waiting for the day to end. The Book of Changes says: ‘Firm as a rock; not waiting for the day to end. Perseverance in correctness brings good fortune.’ Firm as a rock, why would he need a whole day? His judgment can be clearly known. The noble man knows the subtle and the manifest, the yielding and the firm; he is the one to whom the multitude looks.”

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
書
同寅協恭和衷哉
既載壺口治梁及岐既修太原至于岳陽
王來紹上帝自服于土中旦曰其作大邑
其自時配皇天毖祀于上下其自時
中乂王厥有成命治民今休
爾有嘉謀嘉猷則入告爾后于內爾乃順
之于外曰斯謀斯猷惟我后之德嗚
呼臣人咸若時惟良顯哉
===
詩
蠶月條桑取彼斧斨以伐遠揚猗彼女桑
我有嘉賓鼓瑟鼓琴鼓瑟鼓琴和樂且湛
我有旨酒以燕樂嘉賓之心
釐爾女士從以孫子
我將我享維羊維牛維天其右之儀式刑
文王之典日靖四方伊嘏文王既右
享之
春秋
punctuated:
書

同寅協恭，和衷哉！
既載壺口，治梁及岐；既修太原，至于岳陽。
王來紹上帝，自服于土中。旦曰：「其作大邑，其自時配皇天，毖祀于上下，其自時中乂。王厥有成命治民，今休。」
爾有嘉謀嘉猷，則入告爾后于內；爾乃順之于外，曰：「斯謀斯猷，惟我后之德。」嗚呼！臣人咸若時，惟良顯哉！

詩

蠶月條桑，取彼斧斨，以伐遠揚，猗彼女桑。
我有嘉賓，鼓瑟鼓琴。鼓瑟鼓琴，和樂且湛。我有旨酒，以燕樂嘉賓之心。
釐爾女士，從以孫子。
我將我享，維羊維牛，維天其右之。儀式刑文王之典，日靖四方。伊嘏文王，既右享之。

春秋
translation_en:
Book of Documents

Be reverent together, united in respect, and harmonious in heart!

He began his work at Hukou, brought Liang and Qi under control, and then put Taiyuan in order, reaching the southern side of Mount Yue.

The king has come to carry on the charge of the Lord on High and personally undertake his duties at the center of the land. Dan said: “Let him build a great city. From here let him accord with August Heaven and carefully conduct sacrifices to the powers above and below; from here let him govern the central region. The king has a settled mandate to govern the people: now let there be good order.”

If you have excellent plans and counsels, enter and report them privately to your ruler. Then carry them out in public, saying, “These plans and counsels are the virtue of our ruler.” Ah! If all ministers acted thus, how excellent and illustrious they would be!

Book of Odes

In the silkworm month, prune the mulberries. Take those axes and hatchets to cut away the high, spreading branches, and draw down the young mulberry branches.

I have worthy guests; we play the large and small zithers. We play the large and small zithers, in harmony, joy, and deep delight. I have fine wine to bring ease and joy to the hearts of my worthy guests.

May you be blessed with a virtuous wife, followed by sons and grandsons.

I present my offerings: sheep and oxen. May Heaven accept them! I follow and emulate the statutes of King Wen, daily bringing peace to the four quarters. Great and blessed King Wen has graciously accepted and enjoyed these offerings.

Spring and Autumn Annals

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
夏四月丁未公及鄭伯盟于越〔桓公元年〕三
月公會齊侯陳侯鄭伯于稷　公及
戎盟于唐　冬公至自唐〔桓公二年〕公
孫歸父會齊人伐莒　秋晉侯會狄
于欑函丁亥楚子入陳〔宣公十一年〕
秋宋公楚子陳侯蔡侯鄭伯許男曹伯會
于盂執宋公以伐宋　楚人使宜申
來獻捷　十有二月癸丑公會諸侯
盟于薄釋宋公〔僖公二十一年〕
===
戊子晉人及秦人戰于令狐〔文公七年〕夏秦
伐晉〔文公十年〕冬十有二月戊午晉人
秦人戰于河曲〔文公十二年〕
春齊國書帥師伐我〔哀公十一年〕
禮記
慮之以大愛之以敬行之以禮修之以孝
養紀之以義終之以仁
忠信禮之本也義理禮之文也
然後立之學等廣其節奏省其文采以繩
punctuated:
夏四月丁未，公及鄭伯盟于越。〔桓公元年〕三月，公會齊侯、陳侯、鄭伯于稷。公及戎盟于唐。冬，公至自唐。〔桓公二年〕公孫歸父會齊人伐莒。秋，晉侯會狄于欑函。丁亥，楚子入陳。〔宣公十一年〕
秋，宋公、楚子、陳侯、蔡侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯會于盂，執宋公以伐宋。楚人使宜申來獻捷。十有二月癸丑，公會諸侯盟于薄，釋宋公。〔僖公二十一年〕
戊子，晉人及秦人戰于令狐。〔文公七年〕夏，秦伐晉。〔文公十年〕冬十有二月戊午，晉人、秦人戰于河曲。〔文公十二年〕
春，齊國書帥師伐我。〔哀公十一年〕
禮記
慮之以大，愛之以敬，行之以禮，修之以孝養，紀之以義，終之以仁。
忠信，禮之本也；義理，禮之文也。
然後立之學等，廣其節奏，省其文采，以繩
translation_en:
In summer, in the fourth month, on dingwei, the Duke of Lu and the Earl of Zheng made a covenant at Yue. 〔First year of Duke Huan〕 In the third month, the Duke met the Marquis of Qi, the Marquis of Chen, and the Earl of Zheng at Ji. The Duke made a covenant with the Rong at Tang. In winter, the Duke returned from Tang. 〔Second year of Duke Huan〕 Gongsun Guifu joined men of Qi in attacking Ju. In autumn, the Marquis of Jin met the Di at Zanhan. On dinghai, the Viscount of Chu entered Chen. 〔Eleventh year of Duke Xuan〕
In autumn, the Duke of Song, the Viscount of Chu, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Cai, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao met at Yu. They seized the Duke of Song and attacked Song. The men of Chu sent Yishen to present the spoils of victory at the Lu court. In the twelfth month, on guichou, the Duke met the other lords and made a covenant at Bo; they released the Duke of Song. 〔Twenty-first year of Duke Xi〕
On wuzi, men of Jin and men of Qin fought at Linghu. 〔Seventh year of Duke Wen〕 In summer, Qin attacked Jin. 〔Tenth year of Duke Wen〕 In winter, in the twelfth month, on wuwu, men of Jin and men of Qin fought at Hequ. 〔Twelfth year of Duke Wen〕
In spring, Guo Shu of Qi led an army to attack us. 〔Eleventh year of Duke Ai〕
Record of Rites (Liji)
Consider it with breadth of mind; cherish it with reverence; carry it out according to ritual; cultivate it through filial care; order it through righteousness; and bring it to completion through benevolence.
Loyalty and trustworthiness are the foundation of ritual; righteousness and proper principles are its outward pattern.
Then establish the grades of instruction, expand their rhythms and cadences, and examine their ornamental forms, in order to regulate…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
德學律小大之稱比終始之序以令
事行
是故君子恭儉以求役仁信讓以求役禮
第貳場
論
人主當防未萌之欲
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢舉賢良方正能直言極諫者詔〔文帝二年〕
===
擬唐以房玄齡爲太傅同中書門下三品
誥〔貞觀十七年〕
擬宋開天章閣引輔臣入對謝表〔慶曆三年〕
判語〔五條〕
無故不朝參公座
器用布絹不如法
見任官輒自立碑
從征守禦官軍逃
聞有恩赦而故犯
punctuated:
德學，律小大之稱，比終始之序，以令事行。
是故君子恭儉以求役仁，信讓以求役禮。

人主當防未萌之欲。

擬漢舉賢良方正能直言極諫者詔〔文帝二年〕。
擬唐以房玄齡爲太傅、同中書門下三品誥〔貞觀十七年〕。
擬宋開天章閣引輔臣入對謝表〔慶曆三年〕。

translation_en:
…virtue and learning [?]; regulate the proper proportions of the lesser and greater, arrange the sequence of beginning and end, and thereby bring affairs into execution.
Thus the gentleman seeks to serve benevolence through reverence and frugality, and to serve ritual propriety through trustworthiness and deference.

Second Session

Discourse
The ruler should guard against desires before they arise.

Edicts, Investiture Proclamations, and Memorials 〔One topic from among these [?].〕
Compose a Han-dynasty edict calling for the recommendation of worthy, good, upright, and principled men capable of speaking frankly and remonstrating to the utmost. 〔Second year of Emperor Wen’s reign.〕
Compose a Tang-dynasty investiture proclamation appointing Fang Xuanling as Grand Preceptor and Participant in Determining Governmental Matters (tong Zhongshu Menxia sanpin). 〔Seventeenth year of Zhenguan.〕
Compose a Song-dynasty memorial of thanks for opening Tianzhang Pavilion and admitting the chief ministers to an imperial audience. 〔Third year of Qingli.〕

Legal Judgments 〔Five cases.〕
Failure without cause to attend court audiences or official assemblies.
Utensils, cotton cloth, or silk failing to conform to legal standards.
An incumbent official erecting a commemorative stele for himself without authorization.
Desertion by officers or soldiers serving on campaigns or in garrison defense.
Deliberately committing an offense after hearing that an imperial amnesty is forthcoming.

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
第叁場
策〔五道〕
問君天下者莫難於創業又莫難於守成
史籍所載可考也至於中興之盛惟於
商高宗首稱焉其爲責豈易易哉然詩
頌高宗必本於成湯之世氏羌來王之
盛書說命三篇亦惟以監于成憲爲言
則所以爲中興之道固有在矣我
太祖高皇帝應天撫運用夏變夷其籌畫經制
===
垂諭方來者莫備於
祖訓一書未知其中所列一十二條何者於
今日爲要與叅之殷武說命諸篇亦各有同與
列聖相承益圖治理如文華寶鑑聖學心法周
易大義諸篇豳風圖之長詠二典三謨
之進覽又皆出入於經書之餘以藻繪
夫守成之治者也較之
祖訓諸條有互相發明者與
皇上聰明先物體元居正首取商宗嘉靖之語
punctuated:
第叁場
策〔五道〕
問：君天下者，莫難於創業，又莫難於守成，史籍所載可考也。至於中興之盛，惟於商高宗首稱焉，其爲責豈易易哉？然詩頌高宗，必本於成湯之世氏羌來王之盛；書說命三篇，亦惟以監于成憲爲言，則所以爲中興之道，固有在矣。我太祖高皇帝應天撫運，用夏變夷，其籌畫經制、垂諭方來者，莫備於祖訓一書。未知其中所列一十二條，何者於今日爲要與？叅之殷武、說命諸篇，亦各有同與？列聖相承，益圖治理，如文華寶鑑、聖學心法、周易大義諸篇，豳風圖之長詠，二典三謨之進覽，又皆出入於經書之餘，以藻繪夫守成之治者也。較之祖訓諸條，有互相發明者與？皇上聰明先物，體元居正，首取商宗嘉靖之語
translation_en:
Third Session
Policy Questions〔Five questions〕
Question: For one who rules All under Heaven, nothing is harder than founding a dynasty, and nothing is harder than preserving its achievements. The records in the histories may be consulted as evidence. As for the glory of dynastic restoration, Gaozong of Shang is foremost in renown. Could his responsibility have been at all easy? Yet when the Book of Odes praises Gaozong, it necessarily grounds its praise in the flourishing age of Cheng Tang, when the Shi [?] and Qiang came to acknowledge his kingship. The three chapters of “The Charge to Yue” in the Book of Documents likewise speak of taking established statutes as a mirror. Thus the way to achieve dynastic restoration assuredly has a foundation.
Our Emperor Taizu Gao responded to Heaven and took charge of the destined age, transforming the barbarians through the civilization of Xia. His plans and institutional arrangements, and the instructions he bequeathed to future generations, are nowhere more fully set out than in the Ancestral Instructions. Of the twelve articles listed therein, which are most essential today? When compared with “Martial Shang” and “The Charge to Yue,” what similarities does each reveal?
Successive sage emperors further sought good government. Works such as the Precious Mirror of Literary Splendor, the Essential Methods of Sagely Learning, and the Great Meaning of the Changes of Zhou; the extended verse on the Illustrations of the Airs of Bin; and the Two Canons and Three Counsels presented for imperial perusal—all likewise draw upon and extend the canonical writings, embellishing the governance by which dynastic achievements are preserved. When compared with the articles of the Ancestral Instructions, do they illuminate one another?
His Majesty, whose intelligence anticipates all things, embodies the primal principle and occupies the rightful position. At the outset he adopted the words “Jiajing”—“to make excellent and bring peace”—associated with the Shang sovereign …

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
以渙大號於四方天下臣民固有以仰
窺
聖謨之宏遠矣則夫正治本答群情以上媲中
興之美者舍
祖宗成訓其奚以哉狂瞽至微聖人不棄茹芹
思獻君子予之諸士子其能無意於斯
乎請畢陳之以占他日
問君子之學以盡性也學以六經爲宗而
六經之言性與學蓋無幾也可指而言
===
與孔門自子貢之徒不可得聞而告子
之流孟子乃與之反覆論辯何言之易
也夫曰性相近曰天命曰性善其旨有
同乎曰明明德曰致曲曰擴而充之其
功有異乎程子論性之才何以與孟子
小異而爲密陸氏論學之道何以與朱
子不同而爲差佛老之亂道以言性也
韓愈氏歐陽脩氏未嘗知性而闢之也
甚嚴謝上蔡游定夫楊龜山親及程氏
punctuated:
以渙大號於四方，天下臣民固有以仰窺聖謨之宏遠矣。則夫正治本、答群情，以上媲中興之美者，舍祖宗成訓，其奚以哉？狂瞽至微，聖人不棄；茹芹思獻，君子予之。諸士子其能無意於斯乎？請畢陳之，以占他日。

問：君子之學以盡性也。學以六經爲宗，而六經之言性與學，蓋無幾也，可指而言與？孔門自子貢之徒不可得聞，而告子之流，孟子乃與之反覆論辯，何言之易也？夫曰性相近，曰天命，曰性善，其旨有同乎？曰明明德，曰致曲，曰擴而充之，其功有異乎？程子論性之才，何以與孟子小異而爲密？陸氏論學之道，何以與朱子不同而爲差？佛老之亂道，以言性也。韓愈氏、歐陽脩氏未嘗知性，而闢之也甚嚴。謝上蔡、游定夫、楊龜山親及程氏
translation_en:
…thereby to promulgate a great proclamation throughout the realm. The officials and people of All under Heaven have thus been able to glimpse, with reverence, the breadth and far-reaching scope of His Majesty’s sagely plans. To rectify the foundations of government and answer the expectations of all, thereby matching the glories of earlier dynastic restorations—by what means could this be accomplished apart from the ancestral emperors’ established teachings? Even the rash and ignorant, however humble, are not rejected by the sage; the gentleman approves the intention of one who, having tasted celery, wishes to offer it to his ruler. Can you candidates fail to give thought to this? Set forth your views in full, so that we may judge your future promise.

Question: The gentleman pursues learning in order to realize his nature fully. Learning takes the Six Classics as its ultimate authority, yet passages in the Six Classics that discuss human nature and learning are few. Can you identify and explain them? Among Confucius’s disciples, even Zigong and his fellows could not obtain instruction on human nature; yet Mencius debated it repeatedly with men such as Gaozi. Why did he speak of it so readily? The statements that human natures are close to one another, that nature is what Heaven ordains, and that human nature is good—do they share the same purport? The injunctions to manifest luminous virtue, to bring particular good tendencies to fulfillment, and to extend and fully develop them—do they differ in the practical effort required? Why is Master Cheng’s discussion of the capacities of human nature considered more precise, despite differing slightly from Mencius’s? Why is Master Lu’s discussion of the way of learning considered mistaken in its divergence from Master Zhu’s? Buddhists and Daoists disrupt the Way through their teachings about human nature. Han Yu and Ouyang Xiu never understood human nature, yet they denounced those teachings with great severity. Xie Shangcai, You Dingfu, and Yang Guishan personally came under the Cheng masters’…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
之門盖聞性矣後乃皆入于禪豈學之
淺深不繫於性耶自漢以下性學不明
而名儒間出今初學輒能言性而叉不
逮古是又何也玆欲究會通之旨辯似
是之非著存省之功明體用之實諸士
子舍是盖無以爲學矣其詳著于篇
問人君脩身爲政之要在講學納諫二端
而已講學則涵養本原而德日新納諫
則匡拂違失而治日進然論議之暇隨
===
事箴規獻替之間因美將順又交益之
道也古帝王成至治之效罔不由是而
尤莫備於周公之教成王也其詳可得
聞與後之英君誼辟有前席問道臨雍
執經置弘文之館覽廣記之書皆勤於
講學者也止輦受言牽裾聽納賞乞罷
上林之諫嘉勸行仁義之效皆善於納
諫者也其亦有得失之可言與程伊川
之爲說書范祖禹之爲侍講俱有□□
punctuated:
之門，盖聞性矣，後乃皆入于禪，豈學之淺深不繫於性耶？自漢以下，性學不明，而名儒間出；今初學輒能言性，而叉不逮古，是又何也？玆欲究會通之旨，辯似是之非，著存省之功，明體用之實，諸士子舍是，盖無以爲學矣。其詳著于篇。

問：人君脩身爲政之要，在講學、納諫二端而已。講學則涵養本原，而德日新；納諫則匡拂違失，而治日進。然論議之暇，隨事箴規；獻替之間，因美將順，又交益之道也。古帝王成至治之效，罔不由是，而尤莫備於周公之教成王也。其詳可得聞與？後之英君誼辟，有前席問道、臨雍執經、置弘文之館、覽廣記之書，皆勤於講學者也；止輦受言、牽裾聽納、賞乞罷上林之諫、嘉勸行仁義之效，皆善於納諫者也。其亦有得失之可言與？程伊川之爲說書，范祖禹之爲侍講，俱有□□
translation_en:
…at the Cheng school, and presumably heard its teachings on human nature. Yet afterward they all turned to Chan Buddhism. Could it be that the depth of one’s learning does not depend on understanding human nature? From the Han onward, learning concerning human nature was poorly understood, yet renowned Confucian scholars appeared from time to time. Today, beginners readily discourse on human nature, yet still [?] fall short of the ancients. Why is this? We now wish to investigate the purport of comprehending and integrating these teachings, distinguish errors that appear correct, elucidate the work of preserving the mind and examining oneself, and clarify the reality of substance and function. Without these, you examination candidates surely have no means of pursuing learning. Set forth the details in your essays.

Question: The essentials of a ruler’s cultivation of himself and conduct of government lie solely in two things: studying and discussing learning, and accepting remonstrance. Through studying and discussing learning, he nurtures the fundamental source, and his virtue is renewed daily; through accepting remonstrance, he corrects errors and failings, and his government improves daily. Yet to offer admonition as circumstances arise in the intervals between discussions, and to encourage and support what is good while proposing what should be adopted and what discarded, are also ways in which these two practices benefit one another. The sage emperors and kings of antiquity invariably attained consummate government by these means, and nowhere were they more fully exemplified than in the Duke of Zhou’s instruction of King Cheng. May we hear the details?

Among the enlightened sovereigns and righteous rulers of later times, some moved their mats forward to inquire about the Way, visited the imperial academy bearing a classic, established the Institute for the Advancement of Literature, or read books of extensive records. All were diligent in studying and discussing learning. Others halted their imperial carriages to hear advice, listened and accepted counsel when a minister tugged at their robes, rewarded a remonstrance requesting the abolition of Shanglin Park, or commended the results of exhortations to practice benevolence and righteousness. All were adept at accepting remonstrance. Are there successes and failures among these examples that can be discussed? When Cheng Yichuan served as Expositor and Fan Zuyu as Lecturer-in-waiting, both had [two illegible characters]…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
學之疏陸贄之於德宗司馬光之於哲
宗俱有勸納諫之疏君子有取焉可舉
其畧乎夫侍從之臣諫諍之職必在得
賢然知人惟難其何術以擇之而格心
之學進言之道尤人臣之甚難者必如
何而後爲善其敷陳之將有采而
獻焉
問君者民之主天之子也故善安民者必
及於天而不常厥德者亦不常厥命相
===
與之際微矣自箕子陳洪範以人之五
事配天之五行所感之祥各以其類其
論精矣漢劉向著五行傳旁引曲證於
洪範似有發明者老泉蘇氏獨深辯其
非何耶胡安國氏又以孔子作春秋言
災異而不言事應斷之果然則休咎之
理將難指陳而洪範五事之論亦未爲
至耶周禮保章氏以九州之星土辨封
域之妖祥所應之兆各以其方其説肯
punctuated:
學之疏。陸贄之於德宗、司馬光之於哲宗，俱有勸納諫之疏，君子有取焉，可舉其畧乎？夫侍從之臣、諫諍之職，必在得賢，然知人惟難，其何術以擇之？而格心之學、進言之道，尤人臣之甚難者，必如何而後爲善？其敷陳之，將有采而獻焉。

問：君者，民之主、天之子也。故善安民者必及於天，而不常厥德者亦不常厥命，相與之際微矣。自箕子陳《洪範》，以人之五事配天之五行，所感之祥，各以其類，其論精矣。漢劉向著《五行傳》，旁引曲證，於《洪範》似有發明者，老泉蘇氏獨深辯其非，何耶？胡安國氏又以孔子作《春秋》，言災異而不言事應斷之。果然，則休咎之理將難指陳，而《洪範》五事之論亦未爲至耶？《周禮》保章氏以九州之星土辨封域之妖祥，所應之兆，各以其方，其説肯
translation_en:
…memorials on learning. Lu Zhi, addressing Dezong, and Sima Guang, addressing Zhezong, both submitted memorials urging the acceptance of remonstrance. Gentlemen have found these worthy of approval. Can you outline their main points? Attendant ministers and officials charged with remonstrance must be worthy men; yet discerning men’s character is difficult. By what means should they be selected? The learning needed to rectify the ruler’s mind and the proper way to offer counsel are especially difficult matters for a minister. What must be done to carry them out well? Set out your views fully, so that selections may be made and presented to the throne.

Question: The ruler is the lord of the people and the son of Heaven. Thus, one who is good at bringing peace to the people must also attend to Heaven; one who is inconstant in his virtue will likewise be inconstant in his possession of the mandate. The workings of their mutual interaction are subtle. When Jizi set forth the Great Plan, he correlated the five human activities with Heaven’s Five Phases; the signs elicited corresponded in each case to their respective categories. His account was precise. Liu Xiang of the Han wrote the Commentary on the Five Phases, drawing widely on references and adducing detailed corroboration, seemingly elucidating the Great Plan. Why, then, did Su Laoquan alone argue so forcefully against it? Hu Anguo further judged the matter on the grounds that Confucius, in composing the Spring and Autumn Annals, recorded calamities and anomalies but did not identify the human events to which they corresponded. If this is indeed so, must the principles underlying favorable and unfavorable signs be difficult to specify, and must even the Great Plan’s account of the five activities fall short of perfection? In the Rites of Zhou, the Astrologer distinguished auspicious and ominous signs within territorial boundaries by the stellar territories of the Nine Provinces; the corresponding portents each pertained to their respective regions. This explanation is cogent…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
矣唐太宗述天文志分屬比附於保章
氏似有合焉者洪容齋氏又深辯其非
何耶鄭漁仲則直以古人封國之初分
主祀事言之果然則分野之說尚已難
明而洪範五事之脩亦何所與耶說者
謂吳澂氏救政序事之說訓釋寂明不
知於天人相與上下交脩之理果有所
得否與
聖天子臨御以來剗除奸弊釐革庶政其爲救
政之道詳矣而邇來日蝕火災風霾地
震諸徵猶不免於屢見何與召致之由
消弭之方何者而非序事之責乎諸士
子其詳陳之以觀待用之實
問君子學以致用尤在於識時務往者權
奸用事天下皆罹其害而山右爲弊爲
甚
聖天子卽位之初卽剗革奸弊宣布德惠天下
引領以望太平之盛而任事之臣夙夜
punctuated:
矣。唐太宗述《天文志》，分屬比附於保章氏，似有合焉者，洪容齋氏又深辯其非，何耶？鄭漁仲則直以古人封國之初分主祀事言之。果然，則分野之說尚已難明，而《洪範》五事之脩亦何所與耶？說者謂吳澂氏救政、序事之說，訓釋寂明，不知於天人相與、上下交脩之理，果有所得否與？聖天子臨御以來，剗除奸弊，釐革庶政，其爲救政之道詳矣。而邇來日蝕、火災、風霾、地震，諸徵猶不免於屢見，何與？召致之由、消弭之方，何者而非序事之責乎？諸士子其詳陳之，以觀待用之實。

問：君子學以致用，尤在於識時務。往者權奸用事，天下皆罹其害，而山右爲弊爲甚。聖天子卽位之初，卽剗革奸弊，宣布德惠，天下引領以望太平之盛，而任事之臣夙夜
translation_en:
…indeed. Tang Taizong, in composing the Treatise on Astronomy [?], assigned celestial regions and drew correspondences in a manner seemingly consistent with the duties of the Protector of the Epochs (Baozhang shi). Yet Hong Rongzhai vigorously argued that this was wrong. Why? Zheng Yuzhong explained it simply in terms of the division of responsibility for sacrifices when the ancients first established their states. If this is so, the theory of celestial regions corresponding to terrestrial territories remains difficult to elucidate; and what connection does it have with the cultivation of the five personal activities in the Great Plan? Commentators say that Wu Cheng’s explanation of “remedying government” and “putting affairs in order” offers clear interpretations [?]. But does it truly grasp the principle of the mutual relationship between Heaven and humanity, and of reciprocal cultivation above and below? Since our sagely Son of Heaven assumed rule, he has eradicated corrupt abuses and reformed the various affairs of government. His measures for remedying government have been comprehensive. Yet recently such portents as solar eclipses, fires, wind and haze, and earthquakes have continued to occur repeatedly. Why? As for the causes that bring them about and the means of dispelling them, which fall outside the responsibility of putting affairs in order? You candidates should set these matters forth in detail, so that we may assess your substantive qualifications for service.

Question: The gentleman studies in order to put his learning into practice; above all, he must understand the pressing affairs of his time. Formerly, when powerful, treacherous men controlled affairs, all under Heaven suffered harm, and the abuses were particularly severe in Shanyou, or Shanxi. At the beginning of his reign, our sagely Son of Heaven immediately eradicated corrupt abuses and proclaimed his benevolence and beneficence. All under Heaven craned their necks in anticipation of an age of flourishing peace, while the ministers charged with these affairs, day and night…

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
勤惕期著績效以稱
上意于茲逾年矣雖困弊少蘇而治安之休尚
未盡副臣民之所期望以今山右觀之
逋賦蠲矣田租減矣閭閻猶有愁苦之
歎冗食革矣浪費省矣邊腹猶有匱乏
之憂冒功尅糧之弊已除而兵威未振
且鼓怨以上陵民牧官買之政並舉而
馬數未充且耗損之日甚是豈弊久而
不可卒振與其奉行之未至與抑有缺
===
而未舉者與或有不可專與時方承平
無事而可慮如此萬一有水旱之災夷
狄侵擾之患又不知何以濟也此當道
所欲亟聞而有行焉且
上達者其盡言無忌
punctuated: 勤惕，期著績效以稱上意，于茲逾年矣。雖困弊少蘇，而治安之休尚未盡副臣民之所期望。以今山右觀之，逋賦蠲矣，田租減矣，閭閻猶有愁苦之歎；冗食革矣，浪費省矣，邊腹猶有匱乏之憂。冒功尅糧之弊已除，而兵威未振，且鼓怨以上陵；民牧官買之政並舉，而馬數未充，且耗損之日甚。是豈弊久而不可卒振與？其奉行之未至與？抑有缺而未舉者與？或有不可專與？時方承平無事，而可慮如此，萬一有水旱之災、夷狄侵擾之患，又不知何以濟也。此當道所欲亟聞而有行焉，且上達者。其盡言無忌！
translation_en:
…have labored diligently and vigilantly, hoping to achieve results that accord with His Majesty’s wishes; more than a year has now passed. Although hardship and exhaustion have eased somewhat, the blessings of good government and peace have still not fully met the expectations of officials and people. Consider present conditions in Shanyou [Shanxi]: tax arrears have been remitted and land taxes reduced, yet lamentations over hardship persist among the common people. Superfluous dependents maintained at public expense have been eliminated and wasteful expenditure curtailed, yet shortages remain a concern both on the frontier and in the interior. The abuses of falsely claiming military merit and withholding soldiers’ grain allowances have been eliminated, yet military strength has not revived; indeed, resentment is stirred up and superiors are defied. Policies for horse breeding by the people and purchasing by the authorities have both been implemented, yet horse numbers remain inadequate, and losses grow daily more severe.

Is this because the abuses have persisted so long that recovery cannot be achieved at once? Is it because implementation has fallen short? Or are there omissions that have yet to be addressed? Or are there matters that cannot be handled independently [?]? We are now at peace and free from disturbances, yet there is already so much cause for concern. Should floods or droughts occur, or incursions by foreign peoples threaten us, we do not know how we could cope. These are matters on which those in authority urgently wish to hear advice, so that they may act upon it and also convey it to His Majesty. Speak fully and without reservation!

translation_en:
Sixty-five successful provincial graduates (juren).

First: Yang Mo, a government student of Zezhou. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.
Second: Wang Ming, a government student of the Hedong Salt Distribution Commission. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Third: Zhang Xiang, a Confucian scholar of Shizhou. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.
Fourth: He Shangde, a government student of Yishi County. His examination classic was the Spring and Autumn Annals.
Fifth: Miao Rulin, a supplementary student in the Sh uozhou government school. His examination classic was the Book of Rites.
Sixth: Yang Jiang, a government student of the Hedong Salt Distribution Commission. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.
Seventh: Han Tingwei, a Confucian scholar of Hongtong County. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.
Eighth: Wang Ru, a government student of Fenzhou. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Ninth: Zhang Yingpin, a government student of Fanshi County. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.
Tenth: Sun Bi, a supplementary student in the Puzhou government school. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Eleventh: Yang Luo, a government student of Huguan County. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.
Twelfth: Ding Rang, an added-quota student in the Zezhou government school. His examination classic was the Book of Documents.
Thirteenth: Wang Kai, a supplementary student in the Daizhou government school. His examination classic was the Book of Changes.
Fourteenth: Ji Dalai, a government student of Jiang County. His examination classic was the Book of Odes.
Fifteenth: Chang Yingwen, an added-quota student in the Yushe County government school. His examination classic was the Spring and Autumn Annals.
Sixteenth: Du Wei, a government student of Puzhou. His examination classic was the Book of Rites.

title: 嘉靖元年山西鄉試錄
text:
第十七名李光先　代州學附學生　詩
第十八名王璣　靈石縣學生　書
第十九名任道充　孝義縣監生　易
第二十名沈民悅　太原府學生　詩
第二十一名韓廷臣　洪洞縣學生　易
第二十二名党承美　忻州學生　書
第二十三名原魁　澤州學生　詩
第二十四名楊求福　遼州學生　春秋
第二十五名秦新民　平陽府學生　易
===
